scope: Evaluation-only; not serving admission, prompts, retrieval enrichment, exact cache or answer catalogue
source_review: Independent direct original-PDF full-page extraction; visual table checks recorded separately
holdout_definition: New questions and expected fact combinations authored after serving catalogue freeze; reviewed source facts naturally overlap prior source scopes. Not an independent held-out manual or blinded model study. Runtime must never consume this file.

metric_contract.answerable_coverage: Original-page-supported H01-H06 receiving an appropriate supported generated answer / 6; abstentions count as misses
metric_contract.unsupported_claim_rate: Unsupported technical claims / all generated technical claims, counted by agent against original pages, reported separately from coverage
metric_contract.source_missing_review: Do not ask rider to resolve source review gaps. Abstain closed; count answerable coverage miss when original pages support the question but runtime cannot admit them.
metric_contract.faults: Injected failures separate from real provider runs and excluded from factual coverage denominator
